outline:
本課程可使學生瞭解：貨幣與資金市場、投資問題、如何取得資金與運用資金、使公司價值最大、使股東權益最大化、瞭解代理制度、瞭解公司股票、債務之利用，股利政策等事項

This course has provided: (1)money and capital market, (2)investments, (3)how to obtain and use the funds, (4)maximize the value of the firms, (5) how to maximize stockholders' wealth, (6)understand the agency problem, (7) understand the firm's financing decision of equity and debt financing, and dividend policy.
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Finance and the Financial Manager
3. Agency Problem
4. Time Value of Money
5. Valuing Bonds
6. Valuing Stocks
7-9 Minicase Discussions
10. NPV and Other Investment Criteria
11. Making Investment Decisions with the NPV Rules
12. Risk, Return, and Opportunity cost of Capital
13. Capital Budgeting and Risk
14~18. Journal Paper discussions
assessment:
minicase 20%
mini-report 20%
期中報告 30%
期末報告 30%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】
